data.text:
TINGNAN: DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon, ininspeksiyon ang ginagawang bagong drainage system sa Araneta Avenue sa Quezon City.

Ayon sa kalihim, mayroon umanong dati nang drainage system sa lugar ngunit hindi kaya ang dami ng tubig na pumapasok kaya tumataas ang baha tuwing maulan.

Inaasahan na matatapos ang proyekto sa darating na Pebrero. | via Jhomer Apresto/GMA Integrated News

data.text:
LOOK: DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon on Friday inspects the construction of flood mitigation structure along Araneta Avenue in Quezon City.

Several residents complain of widespread flooding along the area.

Dizon says that there are three components for this project: installation of pumping stations, dredging of San Juan River, and clearing of drainage systems. | @DSampangINQ
